pages.text: Before any machine, you need materials Minecraft does not have. TFMG adds them to world generation in three forms:

$(li)$(item)Ores$(): lead, nickel and lithium, as classic veins in stone and deepslate.$(li)$(item)Striated layers$(): thick bands of bauxite, galena, lignite and fireclay in the Overworld, sulfur and fireclay in the Nether.$(li)$(item)Oil$(): deposits on the bedrock floor of the Overworld, and rare oil wells in deserts.
Some resources are not found at all, you make them. $(item)Limesand$() comes from crushing Create's limestone, and $(item)nitrate dust$() (saltpeter) from crushing dirt.

Most of these blocks are worth more once crushed: a pair of Create $(item)crushing wheels$() is the first machine to build. The following pages tell you where each resource is, then what crushing gives.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
